coordinate_system.space: glTF / three.js world space, identical to luffor_cockpit.glb
coordinate_system.from_blender: gltf(x, y, z) = blender(x, z, -y); quaternion_gltf = Rx(-90deg) * quaternion_blender, stored as [x, y, z, w] (matches the node rotations in the GLB)
coordinate_system.camera_convention: camera looks down its local -Z with +Y up (glTF and three.js cameras): camera.position.fromArray(position); camera.quaternion.fromArray(quaternion)

fov_note: fov_vertical_deg_16x9 is three.js PerspectiveCamera.fov at 16:9. For other aspects keep the horizontal fov: vfov = 2*atan(tan(hfov/2)/aspect).
sample_note: Samples are pre-eased at 30 Hz; play them linearly over `duration` seconds, or rebuild from control_point + easing.
